1. Yes, a gentle inline message is right for something that isn’t a valid link.

2. Don’t create a duplicate, but take me to the existing bookmark in an editable state so I can update its title, description, tags, or note.

3. Save it anyway so the link isn’t lost, then let me enter or edit the missing title and description myself.

4. I’d prefer long titles and descriptions shortened with an ellipsis to keep the list easy to scan, with a way to expand them when needed. Tags can wrap onto additional lines.
